Name: GreenGreen Farm
Author: Peekabo0
Description:
[color=#93c47d]GreenGreen [/color][color=#ffffff]is a small-to-medium-sized farm with fully arable land, designed for those who want something simple yet cozy—and the freedom to plant! ૮₍ ˶ᵔ ᵕ ᵔ˶ ₎ა[/color]

[color=#ffffff]Designed for a single player, though cabins can still be built. All grass and soil areas are tillable, with the exception of the stones on the path.[/color][color=#ff0000][size=3] [/size][/color]

[color=#ff0000][size=3]Note: [/size][/color][color=#ffffff][size=3]Does not include cave editing.[/size][/color]

[color=#b6d7a8][size=4]Installation instructions[/size][/color][color=#ffffff]: [/color]
[list=1]
[*][color=#ffffff]Download and unzip the folder. [/color][/*]
[*][color=#ffffff]Copy and paste it into your Mods folder. [/color][/*]
[*][color=#ffffff]Enjoy and play![/color][/*]
[/list]
[color=#b6d7a8][size=4]This farm requires [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/1915]Content Patcher[/url] to work.[/size]

[/color]Mods used in the picture:

[url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/1915]DustBeauty's Foliage and Recolor[/url]
